cases.title: All twelve tools are listed
steps: Bring up graph-manager with the fake forge as TESTING.md "graph-manager" describes, connect GitHub and clone octo/hello

Open a plain terminal in the workspace (POST /api/terminals {"workspaceId":"github~octo~hello"}) and in it run: curl -s -H "authorization: Bearer $GM_INTERNAL_TOKEN" $GM_INTERNAL_URL/api/internal/tools
cases.expected: The tools list holds open_start_run, list_runs, get_run_log, get_node_output, get_artifacts, list_graphs, open_run, open_graph, propose_graph, refresh_ui, cancel_run, resume_run

cases.title: Read tools on a failed fake run
steps: In the workspace commit the fixture diamond/ and spec.md (packages/graph-execution/src/__fixtures__), and start a fake run from the terminal with task:3 failing 3 times (TESTING.md fake script); end it with POST …/view/close
From the terminal call POST $GM_INTERNAL_URL/api/internal/tools/list_runs with {"terminalId":"$GM_TERMINAL_ID","cwd":"$PWD","input":{}} and the Bearer token
Call get_run_log with {runId, lines: 5}, get_node_output with {runId, node: "3"}, and get_node_output with {runId, node: "nope"}
cases.expected: list_runs starts with 'Supervisor: report' and shows the run as failed with its failure; get_run_log returns exactly 5 log lines; get_node_output for 3 shows status failed and a log tail; the unknown node lists the valid node ids

cases.title: Cancel and resume a run
steps: Start a fake run from the terminal with task:3 set to hang
Call cancel_run {runId}; then GET /api/runs/github~octo~hello/<runId>
Call resume_run {runId} without the hang script; call cancel_run on an applied run
cases.expected: After cancel_run the run's status is aborted; resume_run answers 'Resumed run <id>…' and the run goes running then applied; cancel_run on the applied run is an error 'run <id> is not running (applied)'

cases.title: Supervisor setting
steps: GET /api/workspaces/github~octo~hello/supervisor
PUT the same with {"mode":"act"}, then GET again; PUT {"mode":"x"}
In the browser open the workspace settings drawer and look at the Supervisor fieldset
cases.expected: First GET is {"mode":"report"}; PUT returns 204 and GET returns {"mode":"act"}; the bad mode returns 400; the drawer shows 'Report to me' and 'Fix and rerun' with 'Fix and rerun' selected and the hint text

cases.title: Workspace scope and no workspace
steps: Call list_runs with a terminalId of a terminal whose cwd is outside any workspace
Call get_run_log with a runId that does not exist in the workspace
cases.expected: First is isError 'this terminal is not inside a graph-manager workspace'; second is isError 'unknown run <id>'

cases.title: open_run and propose_graph in the browser
steps: Log in with agent-browser, stay on the Runs page
Call open_run {runId} from the terminal; wait 3 s; screenshot
Call propose_graph {tasksDir: "diamond", spec: "spec.md"}; open the toast; screenshot the dialog; click Reject
cases.expected: A toast '… : run <id>' with Open appears and Open goes to /runs/github~octo~hello/<id>; the propose dialog shows the diamond graph with Approve and Reject; after Reject the request is gone from GET /api/agent-requests

cases.title: list_graphs and get_artifacts
steps: Commit a task folder .agents/tasks/demo/ (copy of diamond) in the workspace
Call list_graphs {}; after an applied fake run call get_artifacts {runId}
cases.expected: list_graphs shows .agents/tasks/demo with its task count; get_artifacts lists the <id>.txt files the fake agents wrote

cases.title: Events are not typed into a plain terminal
steps: Start a fake run from the plain terminal (shim) and let it finish
Read the terminal's scrollback (attach over the WebSocket or check the terminal pane screenshot)
cases.expected: No '[graph-manager] Run' line appears in the plain terminal, and the shell did not try to run one as a command
